text:
PARTIALLY DONE. The client/server inversion — the headline defect — is cut. Two of the bead's items remain and are described precisely below. NOT closing.

DONE: ssh no longer compile-depends on agent.

AgentApi moved from agent/AgentService.scala to protocol/AgentApi.scala. It is a WIRE CONTRACT, not a server: it references only core and protocol types, and AgentCall/AgentFailure were already in protocol. Sitting in the agent module meant the SSH client compile-depended on the server assembly — and transitively on cli and local — merely to name the interface it implements.

The ssh tests legitimately drive a real in-process agent for conformance, so agent is now `agent % "test->compile"`. That distinction is the point and is commented in build.sbt: a client may TEST against a server; it may not COMPILE against one.

ALSO FOUND: SharedKernel is already dead. modules/core/.../core/SharedKernel.scala exists but has ZERO references anywhere in the repo — the compatibility aliases ADR 0010 marked removable are already unused, so item 3 of this bead is satisfied in substance. The file needs deleting (this session has no file-deletion permission).

REMAINING, and each is real work rather than cleanup:

1. ssh -> worker. Slurm.scala, RemoteTask.scala and RemoteBatch.scala import worker.SlurmTaskCall and worker.SlurmBatch — the typed task/batch vocabulary. Cutting it means extracting SlurmTask/SlurmTaskCall/SlurmBatch into a `task` module depending only on core, which both worker and ssh then depend on. SlurmTask.scala imports only core, so the extraction looks clean, but it moves the public typed-task entry point and should be done deliberately rather than at the end of a long session.

2. Kernel purity split. remote-exec-kernel still has a catsEffect dependency because AtomicFiles exposes Sync, contradicting ADR 0001 ("Cats Effect and FS2 are confined to interpreter/application modules") while ADR 0010 assigns filesystem mechanics to the kernel. The two ADRs are in tension and the code follows 0010. Splitting means a pure contract artifact plus an effectful filesystem artifact — every AtomicFiles consumer moves to the latter. Note C2 added forceDirectory and C1 added the shared lock, so this split now carries more than it did when the bead was written.

Verification of what IS done: full suite 425 green, zero warnings under -Werror, scalafmt clean.
